description: Fast web server with automatic HTTPS
info:
# Automatic HTTPS via Cloudflare DNS-01 (default path)

This build of caddy includes the caddy-dns/cloudflare provider, so certificates
can be issued over the DNS-01 challenge. DNS-01 proves domain control by writing
a TXT record rather than accepting an inbound connection, which means it works
behind CGNAT, on IPv6-only links, and with no ports forwarded.

Setup:

  1. Create a Cloudflare API token scoped Zone -> DNS -> Edit for your zone:
     https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens

  2. Install the token:

       install -m 600 -o root -g root \
           /etc/caddy/cloudflare.env.example /etc/caddy/cloudflare.env
       # edit /etc/caddy/cloudflare.env and set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=

  3. Uncomment this line in the global block of /etc/caddy/Caddyfile:

       acme_dns cloudflare {env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}

  4. systemctl restart caddy

The acme_dns line ships commented out on purpose: caddy refuses to start when
the token is empty, so enabling it by default would break a fresh install.

The unit pulls the token in with `EnvironmentFile=-/etc/caddy/cloudflare.env`.
The leading `-` makes it optional, and systemd reads it as root before dropping
to the caddy user, so the file stays 0600 root:root.


# Caddyfile example conf with local issued cert
{
    # Restrict the admin interface to a local unix file socket whose directory
    # is restricted to caddy:caddy. By default the TCP socket allows arbitrary
    # modification for any process and user that has access to the local
    # interface. If admin over TCP is turned on one should make sure
    # implications are well understood.
    admin "unix//run/caddy/admin.socket"
    # Use Caddy's internal CA instead of Let's Encrypt/ZeroSSL
    acme_ca internal
    auto_https disable_redirects
}

https://mydomain.sauzeros.org {
    # generate locally issued cert
    tls internal
    root * /usr/share/caddy
    file_server
}


# convert caddy local root.crt and add it to trust store with make-ca
openssl x509 -in /var/lib/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt \
    -text \
    -fingerprint \
    -setalias "Caddy Local Authority" \
    -addtrust serverAuth \
    -addtrust emailProtection \
    -addtrust codeSigning \
    > /etc/ssl/local/caddy_local_root.pem

make-ca -r
